props.label: Krystal's note
props.text: Barry runs the Pocket Branch alone and wants nothing more than to lock up at five. He can't leave until the courier's been. Be the courier. Short and friendly. Watch the meter under his face: that's how suspicious he is.

props.label: Closing-time sign
props.text: Closes at 5:00. Courier pickup before lock-up.

props.label: Swiftbag Couriers pickup schedule
props.text: Swiftbag Couriers — armored courier, end-of-day cash pickup. Picks up the Pocket Branch cash bag at closing. Pickup fee paid on the spot (about 0.50–1 dollar). Barry can't lock up until the courier has been. Contact: Dispatch desk.

props.label: Sticky note on the table
props.text: Barry will agree to anything that gets him home by five. — K.
